google/gemini-2.5-flash-image.notes: 1290 output tokens per image at $30/1M output. Batch via batchGenerateContent (50% off).

google/imagen-4.0-generate-001.notes: DEPRECATED — Imagen 4 (standard/ultra/fast) shuts down 2026-08-17. Recommended replacement: gemini-3-pro-image (pro) or gemini-3.1-flash-image (mid). Kept only so old sidecars still resolve a cost; not in the registry anymore. Note the API shape differs (generate_images → generate_content).

google/gemini-3-pro-image.notes: Gemini 3 Pro Image ("Nano Banana Pro"), GA. $2/M input, $120/M image-output tokens. ~$0.134 per 1K/2K image (1120 tokens), ~$0.24 at 4K (2000 tokens). Batch/Flex 50% off. Verify resolution-specific quotes against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing.

google/gemini-3.1-flash-image.notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image ("Nano Banana 2"), GA. 1024px baseline at $60/M image-output tokens × ~1120 tokens. 2K ≈ $0.101, 4K ≈ $0.151. Verify against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing.

google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image.notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image ("Nano Banana 2 Lite"), GA. Cheapest Gemini image tier at $30/M image-output tokens × ~1120 tokens (≈$0.034 at 1K). Batch 50% off. Default google/small slot. Verify against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing.

openai/gpt-image-2:low.notes: 1024x1024 low quality. Per-image figure derived from token pricing ($5/M text in, $8/M image in, $30/M image out); confirm against the official calculator before relying on it for tight budgets.

openai/gpt-image-2:medium.notes: 1024x1024 medium quality. Per-image figure derived from token pricing; confirm against the official calculator.

openai/gpt-image-2:high.notes: 1024x1024 (1K) high quality. Per-image figure derived from token pricing; confirm against the official calculator. 2K/4K priced separately (:high@2K, :high@4K).

openai/gpt-image-2:low@2K.notes: gpt-image-2 low quality at 2K (~2048x2048). Estimate — low quality is ~$0.01–0.02 at any size. Verify with OpenAI's image cost calculator.

openai/gpt-image-2:medium@2K.notes: gpt-image-2 medium quality at 2K. Estimate scaled from the 1K figure and the high@2K anchor; verify with the calculator.

openai/gpt-image-2:high@2K.notes: gpt-image-2 high quality at 2K (~2048x2048). ~$0.30/image per OpenAI 2026 pricing reports; verify with the calculator.

openai/gpt-image-2:low@4K.notes: gpt-image-2 low quality at 4K (3840x2160). Estimate; low quality tops out around $0.02/image. Verify with the calculator.

openai/gpt-image-2:medium@4K.notes: gpt-image-2 medium quality at 4K. Estimate scaled from the high@4K anchor; verify with the calculator.

openai/gpt-image-2:high@4K.notes: gpt-image-2 high quality at 4K (3840x2160). ~$0.41/image per OpenAI 2026 pricing reports; verify with the calculator.

openai/tts-1.notes: Standard TTS. Not on Batch API.

openai/tts-1-hd.notes: High-definition TTS. Not on Batch API.

openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts.notes: Approximate per-char rate; OpenAI also bills per-token internally. Not on Batch API.

elevenlabs/eleven_turbo_v2_5.notes: Pay-As-You-Go effective rate (~$0.10/1K chars). Plans differ — Creator/Pro/Scale.

elevenlabs/eleven_multilingual_v2.notes: Pay-As-You-Go effective rate (~$0.18/1K chars). Plans differ.

elevenlabs/eleven_v3.notes: Priced the same as Multilingual V2 per ElevenLabs v3 launch blog (post-June-2025 rate). Supports emotion tags ([giggle], [sigh], ...) and multi-speaker via audio tags.

openrouter/google/gemini-2.5-flash-image.notes: Passthrough to Google Gemini Flash Image. OpenRouter may apply small margin (~5%); verify your invoices.

openrouter/google/gemini-3-pro-image-pre.notes: Passthrough to Gemini 3 Pro Image. OpenRouter may apply small margin.

openrouter/google/gemini-3.1-flash-image.notes: Passthrough to Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview ("Nano Banana 2"). OpenRouter may apply small margin; verify on openrouter.ai/google/gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview.

google/gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts.notes: Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS sync. Effective per-char derived from token pricing; verify against current quote. Batch 50% off.

google/gemini-2.5-pro-preview-tts.notes: Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS sync. Approximate per-char. Batch 50% off.

google/gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview.notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS (preview). Newer flash-tier TTS; ~$20/M output (same rate as 2.5 Pro TTS), batch 50% off. Fills the google/tts mid slot. Approximate per-char derived from token pricing; verify against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing.

voicebox/voicebox.notes: Local Voicebox server (voicebox.sh) — $0/call. Engine + model_size selected per profile or via params; no API cost.

pocket-tts/pocket-tts.notes: Kyutai pocket-tts running locally (`pocket-tts serve`) — $0/call. 26 built-in voices plus zero-shot cloning from a reference .wav. MIT code, CC-BY-4.0 weights. Cloning weights are a gated HF repo; run check_pocket to confirm they loaded.

replicate/xai/grok-imagine-video-1.5:480.notes: xAI Grok Imagine Video 1.5 at 480p, billed per second of output (1–15s). Image-to-video only; audio synthesized free. Image input adds ~$0.01/image (not modeled — dominated by per-second). Verify on replicate.com/xai/grok-imagine-video-1.5.

replicate/xai/grok-imagine-video-1.5:720.notes: xAI Grok Imagine Video 1.5 at 720p, billed per second of output (1–15s). Image-to-video only; audio synthesized free. Verify on replicate.com/xai/grok-imagine-video-1.5.

replicate/veed/fabric-1.0:480p.notes: VEED Fabric 1.0 talking-avatar (lip-sync) at 480p, billed per second of output. Output length = input audio duration (clips up to ~5 min). Image + audio → video. Verify on replicate.com/veed/fabric-1.0.

replicate/veed/fabric-1.0:720p.notes: VEED Fabric 1.0 talking-avatar (lip-sync) at 720p, billed per second of output. Output length = input audio duration. Image + audio → video. Verify on replicate.com/veed/fabric-1.0.

replicate/prunaai/p-video:720p.notes: Pruna p-video at 720p, billed per second of output. Image + audio → lip-synced video (avatar tier `low`). Output length = input audio duration, but SILENTLY TRUNCATED AT 20s — the prediction still reports succeeded. Verify on replicate.com/prunaai/p-video.

replicate/prunaai/p-video:1080p.notes: Pruna p-video at 1080p, billed per second of output. Image + audio → lip-synced video (avatar tier `normal`, the default). Same 20s silent truncation as 720p. Verify on replicate.com/prunaai/p-video.

replicate/prunaai/p-video:720p-draft.notes: Pruna p-video at 720p in draft mode — the cheapest avatar rung (tier `draft`), for iteration rather than delivery. Same 20s silent truncation. Verify on replicate.com/prunaai/p-video.

replicate/prunaai/p-video:1080p-draft.notes: Pruna p-video at 1080p in draft mode. Not currently mapped to an avatar tier; priced so an explicit --model override resolves rather than falling through to unknown-cost. Verify on replicate.com/prunaai/p-video.
